title: LandTrendr
label: Annual series
summary: Forty years of a Rondônia forest frontier as straight segments: the year, magnitude and duration of every clearing, and how long the forest took to recover.

title: CCDC
label: Landsat, every date
summary: Harmonic models of every band, breaks when the land changes, and a cloud-free image of any date.

title: S-CCD
label: Landsat, every date
summary: CCDC's models carried forward by a Kalman filter: a forest cleared in 2023, and one being cleared now, shown as a change in progress before it is confirmed.

title: CODED and the NDFI
label: Landsat, every date
summary: Forest degradation apart from deforestation, from the NDFI of every observation.

title: EWMACD
label: Landsat, every date
summary: Thinning and harvests in pine stands found by EWMA control charts on every date, cloudy ones included: when, how strong, and when they recovered.

title: BFAST
label: Regular series
summary: Breaks in trend and season of a 16-day EVI series: BFAST, BFAST Lite and BFAST Monitor.

title: BEAST
label: Annual or regular series
summary: Changepoints with their probability: a clearing BEAST is sure of, a rise it gives 61%, a forest where it claims no change, and maps of how sure it is.

title: Phenology
label: Sub-annual index
summary: The start, peak, end and length of the growing season of every pixel.

title: Trend test (PARTS)
label: Annual series
summary: Whether a region, or each land-cover class, is really trending, when a quarter of its pixels say so.

title: Emerging hot spots
label: Annual series
summary: Where forest and cleared land cluster in forty years of Rondônia, and how that changed: new, intensifying, oscillating or historical hot and cold spots.

title: Noise and change: MNF, CVA, iMAD, radiometric normalization and the radar omnibus test
label: Multiband images, radar series
summary: The minimum noise fraction transform to denoise and reduce a multiband image, change vector analysis and iMAD to map the change between two dates, the radiometric normalization by invariant pixels that puts one date on the scale of another, and the omnibus test that dates the changes of a Sentinel-1 series.

title: Data preparation: topographic correction
label: Surface reflectance, relief
summary: Take the relief's illumination out of surface reflectance with the C-correction or SCS+C: the Copernicus DEM for the series' extent, the sun of each date from its files, and a check of the correlation with the illumination before and after.

title: Spectral unmixing
label: Multiband or hyperspectral
summary: How much forest, soil and water is in each pixel: every date of a Landsat series and every pixel of an EnMAP scene, from endmembers picked with pins.

title: Validation
label: Any map
summary: Strata, a sample, blind interpretation, accuracy and error-adjusted areas with confidence intervals.

title: Tune on samples
label: Any change tool
summary: LandTrendr's parameters searched on the calibration points of an interpreted project, the sets scored and ranked, and the map checked on the points that never tuned it.

title: EOF and lagged correlation
label: Monthly series and a driver
summary: Where the vegetation follows the rain and after how many months, and the few patterns that explain a series of maps: CHIRPS rainfall against NDVI, the lags, the modes and North's test.

title: SNIC segmentation
label: Landsat, every date
summary: Segments of pixels with the same history, their mean series as a layer and their polygons.

title: Field delineation
label: Sentinel-2, a season
summary: A year of Sorriso as 430 field parcels in three seconds, Trazo's published accuracy matched, and the network fine-tuned on fields you draw.

title: Deep learning
label: Landsat, every date
summary: TempCNN, L-TAE and U-TAE trained on MapBiomas samples: a land cover map with its probability and uncertainty, smoothed, and where the model can be trusted.

title: Presto
label: Landsat, a year
summary: A pretrained foundation model's encodings of every pixel: embeddings to explore, and a classifier on them.

title: Raster calculator
label: Any series of bands
summary: EVI and the 275 Awesome Spectral Indices on a Sentinel-2 series, the open layers combined by short names, 107 dates reduced to an image, classes by rules.

title: STAC catalogs
label: Sentinel-2, Landsat, Sentinel-1
summary: An area, two dates, a cloud cover: 375 Sentinel-2 scenes of five dry seasons as a series of 107 dates, read in place from Planetary Computer with the clouds masked; then a year of Sentinel-1 radar over the same square, in dB, a clearing seen through the clouds.

title: Series in and out
label: Any series
summary: 36 loose files built into a series, 107 irregular Sentinel-2 dates put every 16 days with their gaps filled, saved as a NetCDF and a Zarr that xarray reads, and a year of Sentinel-1 through a speckle filter.
learn: Build a series from loose files
Save as COG, NetCDF or Zarr

title: Maps to numbers
label: Any class map
summary: 34 years of MapBiomas on a Landsat series' grid: the hectares of each class every year, the forest patches of 1985 as polygons, and what became of each one, year by year.

title: Embeddings
label: AlphaEarth, TESSERA
summary: Forest, pasture and water from nine pins in milliseconds, what changed into what since 2017, and the direction of every change.

title: Seeing a series
label: Any series
summary: Every pixel compared with a forest and with a pasture, the forest's yearly cycle by wavelet, its six bands over time and 41 years of Landsat as three behaviours in a UMAP plane.

title: The workspace
label: Interface
summary: The status bar and notices, Ctrl+K for any command, Ctrl+G for any coordinate, blend modes, groups and styles, a lens on another date, the provenance and Python of every result, previews, projects and undo.
